description: This PHP file handles the display of the detailed view for an 'Accounts' module in a CRM system, including retrieving account info, checking permissions, preparing display variables, and rendering a template.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A class responsible for CRM entity operations, such as retrieving an instance of a specific module entity.

classes.name: VtigerWebserviceObject
classes.description: Represents the webservice object for a module, used for metadata operations.

classes.name: VtigerCRMObjectMeta
classes.description: Provides metadata information for a CRM object, such as its email fields.

classes.name: Vtiger_Link
classes.description: Handles link generation and retrieval for different module types.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to get an instance of CRMEntity for a given module.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about an entity given its record ID and module name.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Returns the UI blocks for the detail view of a module.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Retrieves and formats update (audit) info for display.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Fetches the sequence number field for a module, if any.

methods.name: useInternalMailer
methods.description: Checks if internal mailer functionality is enabled.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permissions for a specific action on a module or record.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Static method to get a webservice object based on the module name.

methods.name: getEmailFields
methods.description: Retrieves email fields for email sending features.

methods.name: fetchWordTemplateList
methods.description: Gets the list of Word templates for a module.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Generates permissions-based buttons or controls for the UI.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for a given module name.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data for form fields.

methods.name: VT_detailViewNavigation
methods.description: Handles record navigation in the detail view.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Checks if related lists are present for the module.

methods.name: get_use_asterisk
methods.description: Determines whether to display asterisk for required fields based on user settings.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Retrieves related lists for the module.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds related module info to session for UI state management.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves related module info from session.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific fields.

methods.name: getAllByType
methods.description: Retrieves all links of specific types for a module.

methods.name: purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent injection attacks.
